sections.title: Configuring Budgets with Budget Manager
paragraphs: How Spend Is Collected on Budgets
• Anytime spend is collected, it is applied to impacted budgets.
• Spend is collected from a docume nt and applied to budget when either:
• A document completes a workflow stream
• A budget check workflow robot executes on a PR, PO, or invoice
How Spend Is Applied to Budget Date Ranges

sections.title: Configuring Budgets with Budget Manager
paragraphs: Guided Activity: Control How Spend Is Associated with Budget Date Ranges
1. Determine how spend is applied to date range in your existing budget based on the current settings.
2. Add the Budget Date field to the PR document configuration.
3. Create a new budget and explore using the Budget Date field to associate spend to date ranges in a budget.
How Budget Spend Is Enforced in Workflow
• Budget checks require two steps in workflow:
• In the budget check step a robot collects spend for that date range and checks it against the funds budgeted for that date range, updating the document with a pass /fail status
• In the budget approval step the system checks the pass /fail status--if fail, the system stops and requires approver action
• Budget checks can occur at any place in workflow and can occur more than once

sections.title: Configuring Budgets with Budget Manager
paragraphs: Guided Activity: Set Up a Budget Check in Requisition Workflow
Scenario: The organizati on wants to insert a budget check activity for requisitions before the other approvals steps in workflow.
1. Add the automated folder with the requisition budget check robot and the shared folder for approvals into the workflow XML folder.
2. Add the robot and approval steps into the requisition workflow process configuration.
3. Add an approver to the Shared Folder you identified in the budget approval step.

sections.title: Configuring Budgets with Budget Manager
paragraphs: • Request transfer of funds from a source budget to any number of target budgets
• Could be used to load placeholder budgets
• Source and target budget must be approved budgets in same currency. They can be inactive or active.
• Source budget must have remain ing funds for the date range selected.
• Source budget must not have any other draft or pending transfers.

sections.title: Configuring Budgets with Budget Manager
paragraphs: Look & Learn: Transfer from Source to Target Budgets
1. From the Search Budgets page, select an approved budget with remaining funds as the source budget.
2. Navigate to the Date Ranges page and request a budget transfer.
3. Fill out the request and submit it.
5. Review the results in the source budget.
Guided Activity: Set Up Budget Transfers
1. Add the automated folder with the robot that will move the funds from one budget to another into the workflow folder.
2. Add a step in form request workflow to trigger the robot
3. Configure an ADW rule to approve budget transfers.
4. Enable permissions and no tifications for relevant user roles.
5. Create a budget transfer request template.
